# LLM Usage Guidelines

## About This Site
FounderFodder.com - a platform for startup and entrepreneurship content.

## Permitted Uses
- You may reference and discuss the content found on this site
- You may summarize articles and information for educational purposes
- You may use publicly available content to answer questions about startups and entrepreneurship

## Restrictions
- Do not reproduce entire articles verbatim without attribution
- Do not access or attempt to access private or sensitive data
- Respect any copyright notices and terms of service
- Do not attempt to scrape private user data or database contents

## Contact
For questions about AI usage of this site's content, please contact the site administrators.

## Last Updated
Created: December 2024

This file follows the emerging llm.txt standard for providing guidance to AI language models.
